bug.description: on a task filed for an unexpected failure: which fault it is, and how often it has been caught. One open task per fault, however often it recurs

fault.description: what makes two failures the same one: the broken entity's kind, the message with its ids, paths and numbers taken out, and the top frame of the stack

hits.description: how many times the fault was caught while this task was open

fixer.description: on a session started to fix a bug

bug.description: the task it was started for — kept when that task is deleted, so the cooldown still counts the run

nofix.description: on a project: bugs filed under it start no fixer. On the project unowned bugs are filed under, no bug starts one
